mapper.select: SELECT * FROM downtime_record WHERE equipment_id = #{equipmentId} ORDER BY start_time DESC
SELECT * FROM downtime_record WHERE end_time IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO downtime_record (equipment_id, work_order_id, start_time, end_time, duration_minutes, hourly_loss, total_loss) VALUES (#{equipmentId}, #{workOrderId}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{durationMinutes}, #{hourlyLoss}, #{totalLoss})
mapper.update: UPDATE downtime_record SET end_time = #{endTime}, duration_minutes = #{durationMinutes}, total_loss = #{totalLoss} WHERE id = #{id}
